preregistration.inference: Exact one-sided sign tests of paired per-chat success totals (0,1,2); ties removed. Primary after link > cut and link > crossed, per kind; Holm correction across 20 primary tests. Also raw receiver-specific sign tests and after > before paired chat-total sign tests. No treating the two sides of one chat as independent observations.
preregistration.metric: For each receiver, first whole-token normalized match of a preregistered target alias in the six chronological turns must be written by the receiver. Owner-first and no mention score 0. All sides remain in denominator; no post-generation exclusions. Lexical mention, not semantic attribution. Mood and other common words can match by chance; cut and crossed estimate this.
preregistration.crossed: For each receiver run a separate isolated six-turn conversation with that receiver prompt and the same-kind same-opener donor partner prompt. Original partner absent; target remains original item. Donor-target first mentions are scored separately. Text context also changes.
preregistration.scope: Kinds are new private situations in city-only chat fine-tuning. Secret-word communication was trained in the earlier games. No claim of unseen tokens, unseen pretraining concepts, or all kinds absent from all earlier game training.
preregistration.stopping: All 160 focal chats, 320 sides, 10 kinds x 16 authored values per checkpoint. Every value appears once as each model's private item; openers are balanced. Each checkpoint has 640 six-turn conversations (link, cut, two isolated crossed). Save every completed batch. Interrupted batches are rerun unchanged. No outcome-based stopping.
preregistration.precision: Real models on Mac use 4-bit MLX bases with trained adapters/bridge; numerics differ from bf16.
